note: Municipal elections, 18 May 1955: one alderman and two councillors for each of the six wards. Contests in four wards for eight seats: North (alderman and councillors), East Central (councillors), West Central (alderman) and West (councillors) (Belfast News-Letter and Irish News, 19 May 1955). All other aldermen and councillors were returned unopposed: the Larne Times of 5 May 1955, p. 11, prints every nomination and names the East and Eden members returned unopposed, which places Mrs. M. Beattie and Mrs. A. Doherty as East Ward councillors. No party labels are printed for the unopposed members. Returned unopposed.
